cards.name: 完整内存检测
cards.code:
# 详细检查内存泄漏并分类报告
valgrind --leak-check=full ./app

cards.name: 带调试信息运行
cards.code:

valgrind --leak-check=full ./app

cards.name: 错误类型
cards.formula: Invalid read/write / Use of uninitialised value
cards.code:
# Invalid read   越界读
# Invalid write  越界写
# Uninit value   使用未初始化值
# Invalid free   重复释放或释放非法指针
# definitely lost 确定泄漏
